overview: The Basilica of Adumbration is an ancient Luclinite arcane megastructure built to stabilize and study void resonance.
history: Constructed by early Luclinite arcane orders to harness void resonance.
Arcane pylons were erected to channel energy into the Basilica’s core.
Custodian entities formed from void‑arcane fusion to maintain the structure.
Akhevan forces discovered the Basilica and attempted to seize its secrets.
The Basilica’s geometry destabilized after a catastrophic resonance event.
hooks: A resonance core pulse destabilizes the Basilica’s halls.
Akhevan ritualists attempt to breach the sanctum.
Arcane pylons begin overloading in sequence.
